note: Hub media density (issue #90). Every external figure on the hubs is reused from the ST register (src/data/sales/stats.ts, sources fetched 2026-10-14 per WP-58) or from the WP-35 datasets (src/data/datasets/figures.ts, retrieved 2026-10-15); WP-24 fetched nothing new. The ids per route are HUB_STATS and HUB_FIGURES in src/components/hubs/stats.ts. Counts drawn on the hubs (articles per desk, documents per kind, pages per stage and kind, questions per topic, reading minutes) are computed at build time from this site's own content and are credited to World Enterprise Group Incorporated; they are not external claims. Diagrams and illustrations are authored SVG with no third-party imagery.
